description: Fast and low overhead web framework for Node.js. Rich HTTP routing with schema-based validation — ideal for surfacing contract-change blind spots on route handlers and plugin interfaces.
End-to-end typesafe APIs for TypeScript. Procedure definitions are direct API contracts — any input/output schema change is a contract-change blind spot candidate.
Ultrafast web framework for Cloudflare Workers, Deno, and Bun. Route handler and middleware boundaries provide high-signal integration points for blind spot detection.
FastAPI — high performance Python API framework built on Pydantic and OpenAPI. Pydantic model changes on route parameters and response models are canonical contract-change blind spots.
Lightweight Python WSGI web framework. Route decorator changes and request/response object modifications represent integration boundaries where blind spots commonly surface.
